'''2010 Ohio State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship at Origins in Columbus, Ohio, on 26 June 2010.<ref name="eier">[http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=563&p=565033 results], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forums (Brad Eier, 27 June 2010; topic title "results", Origins forum). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100717050148/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=563&p=565033&sid=37acf71d5b89bc7d2f2bad453f9c37da Internet Archive, 17 July 2010].</ref> The [[2010 Origins Mini-Open]] was the same day.<ref name="eier" />

Nine players entered. After Swiss, ordered by victory points then differential, [[Brad Eier]] took the trophy and Pat Johnson took the Worlds bye.<ref name="eier" />

== Format ==

* '''Players:''' 9<ref name="eier" />
* '''Date:''' 26 June 2010<ref name="eier" />
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio<ref name="eier" />
* '''Swiss order:''' victory points, then differential<ref name="eier" />

== Results ==

The post names the top two after Swiss. Deck names are his spellings.<ref name="eier" />

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Swiss order !! Player !! Result !! Decks as posted
|-
| 1 || [[Brad Eier]] || Trophy || intanglements and reb senate
|-
| 2 || Pat Johnson || Worlds bye || rops and wys
|}

Shewski agreed that the listed decks were a pre-7.1 format, and wrote that it was one of the final events before the new cards became legal.<ref name="eier" />
